result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification read the story, tech design, test plan, implementor package, changed production paths, and TC-5.x tests. Story and epic gates passed, but the production edit path has one blocking validation gap: it accepts messages that are not in a closed turn.

newFindings.title: messages.edit accepts turnless messages instead of enforcing the closed-turn target boundary
newFindings.evidence: Story scope requires messages.edit to validate a closed-turn target (story lines 15-20), and AC-5.1 is scoped to editing a message in a closed turn. In code, readMutableMessage explicitly allows turnStatus null for a gap/no-membership message (packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/internal/store.ts:48-79), and messages.edit only refuses target.turnStatus === 'open' before applying the edit (packages/lhc/src/domains/messages/index.ts:411-434). I verified the production path with an ad hoc runtime scenario: a thread containing only a runtime_note before any prompt produced m1 with no turnId; messages.edit({ messageId: 'm1', content: 'edited gap' }) returned ok:true with changed.messageIds ['m1'] and an empty cascade, and listMessages showed the content mutated. That changes sanctioned record state outside the required closed-turn class.
requirementIds: Story Scope: validate target closed turn
